scope: Independent UX/accessibility review of simplified workspace, Settings relocation, request/approval, reactive editing, navigation and cold display. Approval is source-bound and does not mark UX001 or VSLICE004 Accepted.

independentTests.command: env -u QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY WB_REPOSITORY_ROOT="$PWD" REGISTRY_PYTHON="$PWD/target/vs2-venv/bin/python" WB_UX_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/ux001-independent-ux QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QT_QUICK_BACKEND=software target/ux-001-tests/ux-001-tests
independentTests.observed: All9 named UX cases passed; totals11 including init/cleanup,75.044s. Actual Qt framework accessibility backend active and delivered alerts asserted.

findings.finding: Pinned-list rebuild on every unrelated state event discarded keyboard selection.
findings.fix: Rebuild only when room summaries change and preserve prior focused selection; sync selected row only on native room selection change.

findings.finding: Missing recovery data during startup was interpreted as a recovery error.
findings.fix: Use explicit recovery string and opening state.

findings.finding: Saved-state wording could misrepresent pending, unapplied or failed edits.
findings.fix: Normal workspace status prioritizes busy/draft/error and neutral workspace-open wording. Partial topology/initialization response is handled before generic unchanged-state errors.
findings.retest: ux_006_partial_initialization_and_draft_truthfulness passed; actual adversarial guest and retained draft used.

findings.finding: Started-workspace screenshot retains legacy Room/short-ID row wording despite the Workspace heading.
findings.note: Presentation-only inconsistency; navigation still uses exact persisted room IDs and accepted bridge. Future chat-focused iteration can reapply display labels after legacy refresh.

findings.finding: Components Settings still shows legacy choose-component/create-canvas placeholder hints although direct launch is intentionally hidden/disconnected.
findings.note: Read-only behavior independently verified by double-click nonmutation test. Wording can be cleaned up in the subsequent iteration.

observations: Default screenshot has workspace/pinned/recent navigation, centred Operator conversation and an empty canvas; no component administration controls visible.
Components Settings screenshot shows actual installed version/full pin/registry information; controls are read-only and no alternate start path is mounted.
Actual semantic-canvas screenshot shows three mortgage inputs and committed1461.48 output; shell grab cannot capture embedded native canvas, so separate native canvas grab is retained.

QML source diff from accepted VS3 renderer is limited to hasDraft guard on editingFinished. Focus-only transitions cause no invocation; actual QML keystrokes still traverse accepted draft/edit ingress and recalculate1753.77 with one mocked request.
Separate offline cold process proved exact restored state, zero model and guest display calls, and denied IPv4/IPv6.
Provider consent is session scoped and conversation history is local UI only; current-request outbound projection checked independently.
Private Qt accessibility activation is confined to explicit test client setup; this is event/focus evidence, not human screen-reader certification.
Legacy Shell/Bridge/worker and accepted contract bytes remain unchanged. New product entry routes through the same DirectPanel/native execution path.
limitations: Hosted Linux CI and real-provider walkthrough are separate gates; this review does not claim either ran.
User has redirected the next iteration toward chat-first UI; this approval remains specific to375b200 and cannot be reused for later source changes.
Recent activity/conversation are session-only presentation and not added to room snapshots.
